business_summary: China Investment and Finance Group Limited is an equity fund launched and managed by China Everbright Securities (HK) Limited. The fund invests in the equity markets of Greater China. China Investment and Finance Group Limited was formed on April 26, 2002 and is domiciled in Cayman Islands.
business_summary_ko: China Investment and Finance Group Limited는 China Everbright Securities (HK) Limited가 출시하고 관리하는 주식형 펀드입니다. 본 펀드는 중화권 주식시장에 투자합니다. 중국 투자 금융 그룹 유한회사(China Investment and Finance Group Limited)는 2002년 4월 26일에 설립되었으며 케이맨 제도에 주소지를 두고 있습니다.
